* A statue of the Chinese monster Pixiu at Wat Hiranyawat (วัดหิรัญญาวาส), a Buddhist temple I passed by during my aimless trip in Northern Thailand.
Located in Ko Chang Subdistrict, Mae Sai District, Chiang Rai Province, the temple is heavily visited by Shan people from the neighboring country Myanmar.
